subject: Matador Health — AWS co-sell bridge and demo roadmap sync
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@amazon.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@matadorhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Matador Health <> Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Hi Logan —

Quick intro: I’m Tom from the AWS partner co-sell team and I work with Matador Health on cloud transformation. Matador is evaluating options to reduce inference cost and improve latency for their clinical NLP pipelines — I think Redwood Inference is a great fit for the use case and I wanted to connect both teams to scope a short POC and align on procurement cadence.

Proposed next steps:
- 30–45m intro call to confirm goals and timeline
- Share a short mutual action plan (MAP) covering technical validation, procurement, and procurement gates
- Identify security contacts for preflight items (SOC2, data retention, KMS)

Are you available for a quick sync next week (Tue/Wed AM PT)? I’ve attached a one-pager for context.

Attachment: matador-intro-onepager.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
AWS Partner Co-sell
Amazon Web Services
treynolds@amazon.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Matador Health <> Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Tom — thanks for the intro and the one-pager. Excited to get this moving.

Suggested agenda for the intro call (30–45m):
1) Quick intros & success criteria (5–7m)
2) Matador’s current infra & latency/cost targets (10m)
3) Redwood demo + topology fit (10–15m)
4) MAP / next milestones (procurement timing, SOC2 preflight, on-prem vs VPC choice) (10m)

I can take ownership of the MAP and will circulate a draft beforehand. Proposed slots: Tue 9/7 9–9:45am PT or Wed 9/8 10–10:45am PT. If neither works tell me two windows that do.

CC’ing Karthik (solutions) and Kimberly (procurement lead) so we have coverage.

Also adding a Mural draft for the MAP I’ll populate: https://app.mural.co/m/matador-redwood-ma-plan — I’ll drop a version 1 (tech + procurement milestones) by EOD Thursday. HubSpot deal ID: MD-2027-0918.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0183
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Matador Health <> Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Adding a quick procurement/security note:
- We should add security preflight to the MAP as an early gate — SOC 2 Type II evidence, data retention policy, KMS integration notes.
- Mina, can you own the security checklist and confirm what artifacts we’ll surface during the intro?

Also, procurement tends to move faster if we provide a simple pricing band and an estimated runway for the POC (2–6 weeks typical). I can prepare a POC commercial term sheet if you want — it’s often helpful to show a clear runway and procurement dependencies.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@amazon.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@matadorhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@matadorhealth.com>, Avi Kapoor <avi.kapoor@matadorhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Matador Health <> Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Thanks — Matador confirmed attendees and picked Wed 9/8 10–10:45am PT. Calendar invite is out (please accept).

Matador attendees:
- Sara Bennett, Director of Engineering (sara.bennett@matadorhealth.com)
- Liam O'Connor, Head of ML Ops (liam.oconnor@matadorhealth.com)
- Avi Kapoor, Procurement (avi.kapoor@matadorhealth.com)

They asked for two things ahead of the call:
1) An outline MAP (even a spreadsheet) that maps milestones to owners and expected dates
2) SOC2 and basic security artifacts to assess timeline for procurement

I’ve added a short AWS note on expected co-sell cadence: if the MAP shows a clear POC runway and procurement windows, AWS will prioritize an intro to the field sales lead for credits evaluation.

Invite attachment: meeting-agenda.docx (stub)

Please loop Mina for the SOC2 deliverables.

—
Tom
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@amazon.com>, Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@matadorhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@matadorhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Matador Health — AWS co-sell bridge and demo roadmap sync

Appreciate the quick schedule confirmation and the attendee list.

I attached the first draft MAP (redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx) — it includes:
- Week 0: Intro + goals (this Wed)
- Week 1: Tech fit demo + sample dataset test (we’ll need a small anonymized sample; see secure upload instructions below)
- Week 2–3: POC run and perf/cost reporting
- Week 4: Exec review + procurement runway decision

Secure sample upload: Please use AWS S3 presigned URL (I can generate a short-lived link after the call) or share via an approved SFTP. We cannot accept PHI in plain email.

Kimberly — if you can provide a POC commercial term and Mina — the SOC2 artifact bundle, we’ll be ready to present to Matador.

Looking forward to the call. I’ll join from my calendar and will share the final MAP before the meeting.

Attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
